name: Central Market (Bazaar central)
subtitle: The main market of Port Louis, with fish, meat, grocery and fresh produce sections.

facts.label: Origin of market sales
facts.value: First fruit and vegetable sales were held in front of St Louis Cathedral in 1773.

facts.label: Fire of 1816
facts.value: A fire destroyed the market on 25 September 1816.

facts.label: Building
facts.value: Bazaar central built in 1845 with four wings; fish and meat wings survived to 2012 without major repairs.

facts.label: Later fires and reconstruction
facts.value: Fires destroyed the grocery section (19 May 1981) and vegetable section (4 November 1999); reconstruction completed 11 March 2004.

parts.text: The main market of Port Louis, with fish, meat, grocery and fresh produce sections. Its present layout dates from the 1845 building, with later reconstruction after fires.
